description: Change the region update logic to use regionStart() instead of regionEnd() for the second argument, breaking parsing of patterns with multiple fields.
Replace inequality check with equality check in the leftover pattern validation, suppressing exceptions when trailing invalid characters remain.
Swapped currentFormatField and nextFormatField assignments, assigning the wrong field name to the current iteration.
Omit the final strategy addition after the loop exits, missing the last strategy for patterns that complete the loop normally.
Initialize timeZone parameter incorrectly by using default instead of the passed timezone when initializing thisYear.
